# PollOption

## Documentation

Contains information about one answer option in a poll.

### Parameters

- **`text`** (`str`)
  Option text, 1-100 characters.

- **`voter_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of users that voted for this option.
  Equals to 0 until you vote.

- **`data`** (`bytes`, *optional*)
  The data this poll option is holding.

- **`entities`** (List of [`MessageEntity`](MessageEntity.md), *optional*)
  Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the option text.

- **`media`** ([`InputMediaPhoto`](../input_media/InputMediaPhoto.md) | [`InputMediaVideo`](../input_media/InputMediaVideo.md) | [`InputMediaAnimation`](../input_media/InputMediaAnimation.md) | [`InputMediaAudio`](../input_media/InputMediaAudio.md) | [`InputMediaDocument`](../input_media/InputMediaDocument.md), *optional*)
  Media of the option. When sending, an input media; in received polls, the media object
  ([`Photo`](Photo.md), [`Video`](Video.md), ...).

- **`author`** ([`Chat`](../user_and_chats/Chat.md), *optional*)
  The user or chat that added the option, for options added after the poll was created.

- **`addition_date`** (`datetime`, *optional*)
  Date the option was added, for options added after the poll was created.

- **`parse_mode`** ([`ParseMode`](../../enums/ParseMode.md), *optional*)
  When sending, how to parse *text* if there are no *entities*.
  By default, it is parsed using both Markdown and HTML styles.
